riskRegister.description: PUTT regression — high-NSI player whose neutral skill is propped by non-transferable putting; links T2G weak
Zero links evidence cap — no links or Birkdale rounds; modelled links_delta capped to ±1.5
OTT-only links signal — OTT positive at GSO but APP collapsed; Birkdale's precision layout punishes this split
Birkdale depth gate — thin Birkdale sample (<6 rounds) inflating VHN above neutral
History vs current-form conflict — meaningful Birkdale history contradicted by catastrophic 6m links form
Putting-led links total — positive GSO total driven by PUTT alone; T2G rank collapses without putter
Links APP gate — below-threshold APP at links courses; Birkdale demands elite approach play inside 175 yds
Form spike unconfirmed — HOT/WARM form class not validated by links-course evidence
